results.title: Xi's peace principles offer little cover for China in Africa - Asia Times
results.snippet:
Beijing posted its first defense attaché to Niger last year, and Mali has taken delivery of Chinese short-range air defense systems. China National Petroleum Corp (CNPC) built Niger’s oil export pipeline to Benin, while Chinese companies mine and build across western Mali.

results.title: Kodal targets Ghana lithium growth beyond Mali mine - MINING.COM
results.snippet:
Kodal’s Bougouni lithium mine, a joint venture with China’s Hainan, began production in 2025. The company also holds gold exploration assets in Mali and Ivory Coast, giving it an established regional presence as it pursues opportunities in battery metals.
